name: 3D Texture Proxy Geometry — 3D Texture Proxy, View-Aligned Slices, 3D-Texture Volume Rendering, 3D Texture-Based Volume Rendering
definition: A direct volume rendering method that represents the volume as a series of parallel planes for rendering, utilizing 3D texture maps in hardware to interpolate color values computed independently at each voxel.
summary: 3D Texture Proxy Geometry renders volumes using view-aligned textured slabs, enabling runtime-adjustable plane counts and perspective views without shear-warp limitations.
